purpose: Teach: すてき/好ん/呟い/見失っ/うまかっ/脱ぎ/日当たり/当っ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、ママの新しいお洋服、すてきでしょ?
lines.en: Sho, don't you think Mama's new dress is lovely?
lines.style: Warm, inviting tone. Speaking to a child she adores. Slight uplift at the end — seeking his genuine opinion, not just admiration. Open and present.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お野菜の中でトマトを好んで食べるよ
lines.en: Mom, I like eating tomatoes best out of all the vegetables.
lines.style: Bright clarity. Small voice, but certain. Speaking as if he's thought about this carefully. Earnest in the way only a six-year-old can be about vegetables.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが何か呟いてたわよ
lines.en: Sho, Dad was saying something under his breath earlier.
lines.style: Casual observation, not quite a complaint. Thinking out loud in his presence. Warm but matter-of-fact — the small passing comment a parent makes.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お友達を駅で見失ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I lost track of my friend at the station.
lines.style: Small, worried admission. Quieter than before. Sounding like he's confessing something that bothered him more than he wants to show.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんの作ったお料理、うまかったね
lines.en: Sho, the food Dad made today was really delicious, wasn't it?
lines.style: Warm recollection. Not asking about the dish itself — affirming something good that happened. The tone of someone remembering a small happiness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お風呂上りに服を脱ぎっぱなしダメだよね
lines.en: Mom, I shouldn't leave my clothes all over the bathroom after my bath, right?
lines.style: Seeking reassurance through self-awareness. Small voice checking if he's understood correctly. Earnest and slightly uncertain — wanting to be told he's learning.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖母ちゃんちは日当たり最高よ
lines.en: Sho, Grandma's place gets such wonderful sunlight.
lines.style: Bright, almost celebratory observation. Speaking with pleasure about a place he likes. The tone of someone sharing something small that delights her.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お年玉付きの年賀状が当ったよ
lines.en: Mom, my New Year's card with the lottery ticket won!
lines.style: Open, unbridled happiness. Rushing the words slightly in his excitement. Small chest out — proud of his luck and eager to share it.
